sheets.prompt: Create a new LANDSCAPE 16:9 character production concept sheet for the original game ARCANA GUARDIANS, expanding the supplied art into a NORSE / VIKING FJORD REGION. Use image1 for coherent clean stylized 3D sculpt quality, readability and sheet layout, image2 for the existing cold-region navy/teal cloth, ivory fur, restrained brass and icy cyan accents. Create NEW HUMAN Nordic fantasy characters, not the existing mage/elf/dwarf or bear/navigator. A confident adventure strategy-action game aesthetic, adult characters with substantial chunky hands/boots, about 3.5 to 4 head heights, rounded beveled large forms, readable at small scale, crafted rough iron, oak, leather, woven wool and fur; not photoreal people, not plush baby toys, not dense MMO filigree. Exactly three distinct columns. LEFT: AXE WARDEN, adult broad human man with copper-brown braided beard, sturdy nose-guard IRON HELMET WITHOUT HORNS, weathered dark iron shoulder plates, slate/navy wool tunic, rust-red sash, modest cream fur collar, broad dark boots. One heavy TWO-HANDED LONG-HAFT BEARDED AXE, a thick wide wedge iron axehead with simple brass collar, oak shaft and leather grip. No giant hammer, no shield, no dual axes. His silhouette is a wide triangle, clearly human not a dwarf. MIDDLE: SHIELD SENTINEL, adult athletic woman with long ash-blond braid, uncovered face and head (no helmet), teal wool tunic over chainmail skirt, layered brown leather armor, blue-grey leg wraps and substantial boots. Anatomical LEFT arm carries one round oak-plank shield with dark blue painted quadrants, central metal boss and iron rim; anatomical RIGHT hand carries one long spear with broad steel leaf blade and small teal pennant tied below the head. Tall/slender diagonal spear silhouette, functional non-sexualized armor. RIGHT: RUNE SEER, older lean male human with grey beard, dark navy hood and long split wool coat, brown belt pouches, ivory fur capelet, boots visible, one crooked oak staff with a single slate RUNE STONE suspended in a brass cradle; restrained cyan incised abstract marks on stone, small amber lantern and three chunky hanging stone charms on belt. No pointed wizard hat, no enormous antlers, no weapon arsenal. Tall narrow hooked staff silhouette. Use generic original fantasy engraved geometry, not copied modern insignia or franchise symbols. Clean warm stone-gray studio background, shared soft lighting and grounded feet. TOP52%: large full-body FRONT THREE-QUARTER ready poses for all three on the SAME baseline at believable comparable scale. MIDDLE30%: separated SIDE and BACK mini views of EACH SAME character, same anatomical weapon hands, hairstyle and gear attachment, clear shield backside straps, staff grip and cloak split. No mirror-induced weapon swapping. BOTTOM18%: one planted combat keypose and an isolated signature weapon under each column: axe warden low-knee two-handed axe wind-up; sentinel braced left-arm shield with spear thrust from RIGHT hand; seer planted staff channel with one small blue rune arc away from body. NO explosive VFX obscuring anatomy, no snow particles, no scenery/HUD/stats. Preserve same gear between all views. Main title 'ARCANA — FJORD GUARDIANS', short labels 'AXE WARDEN', 'SHIELD SENTINEL', 'RUNE SEER'. These are modeling reference illustrations, not actual finished 3D assets.

sheets.prompt: Create a NEW LANDSCAPE 16:9 NORDIC / VIKING FJORD ENVIRONMENT production reference sheet for original game ARCANA GUARDIANS. Directly use attached source images for the established quality: image1 cold-region navy sea, icy cliff depth, teal/navy/brass/amber palette and open traversal; image2 readable constructed settlement volumes and isolated modules. This NEW REGION must be distinct from the polar masonry fort and the verdant teal-roof castle: use thick DARK OAK TIMBER LONGHOUSES, steep overlapping weathered shingle roofs with snow only on shaded edges, practical carved interlaced beam ends, ROUND SHIELDS hung on hall sides, rough grey stone foundations, chunky timber PALISADE, deep blue/teal cloth banners, AMBER iron-caged lanterns, dark pine clusters, narrow fjord, exposed granite/basalt ridges and a small LONGSHIP. No medieval stone castle, no eastern pagodas, no tropical plants, no all-white flat snow field, no copied franchise architecture, no horns on every roof. Premium stylized sculpted game art with chunky bevels and practical large shapes, visible wood joinery and roof thickness, restrained small details. Upper62%: one large three-quarter 35-degree elevated DIORAMA with readable height. LOWER wooden harbor deck has a moored small longship with curled carved prow, visible bench seats and furled blue cloth sail so it does not block the village. Harbor connects to upper village by a BROAD gentle granite-and-dirt RAMP which visibly meets both surfaces, with sturdy low stone retaining edges. The upper plateau contains ONE distinct large meeting/feasting LONGHALL at rear, TWO small timber dwellings and ONE smithy with short chimney and anvil. A gate of thick timber posts and low palisade opens onto the central action space. A short sturdy TIMBER bridge crosses a narrow glacial stream at left; both landings connect to traversable ground. Preserve large empty central road and courtyard and keep trees at outer perimeter. Four circular rough-stone tower sockets, TWO occupied with distinct Nordic defense shapes: one low oak-frame iron-bolt ballista (horizontal bow, rotating base), one vertical slate rune beacon with simple brass supports and a cyan central stone (vertical silhouette). Do not flood everything with runes; broad planks and stone shapes first. Light frost and snow accents sit over rock/earth thickness, deep fjord water lower than the dock. No heroes, enemies, HUD, levels, floating disconnected terrain or fake dimension labels. LOWER38%: on warm neutral studio ground, SIX large isolated module groups matching the main scene: (1) same longhall front3/4 with full roof and foundation; (2) same timber gate and short palisade segment; (3) longship side3/4 with whole hull/keel and furled sail; (4) ballista and rune beacon paired, full bases, separated; (5) granite ramp/retaining-wall section paired with short timber bridge; (6) practical props: circular oak shield, iron-caged amber lantern, barrel and supply chest. Each with readable contacts and construction; keep structural joints visible. Small restrained swatches for oak, slate, iron, wool, fur, ice. Title 'ARCANA — NORDIC FJORD KIT'. Short English module labels only. This is future real-modeling reference art, not a screenshot of an implemented 3D map.
